messages:
Marta (Design): hey team — putting up a quick comp for the latency observability page. focus: p95 bands + heatmap density + new 'quick range' chips + sampling slider. PTAL :wave:
Sachin (Eng-Platform): looks good at first glance. can we keep the heatmap legend from overlapping the y-axis labels when width < 760px?
Marta (Design): good catch. I swapped legend to a top floated row for narrow screens in latest comp. should we instead make it toggleable? :thinking:
Eli (Eng-ML): toggle fine but prefer auto-collapse to a single chevron — reduces micro-interaction cost. also: how heavy are the render ops for high-res heatmap? we might need progressive tiles.
Anna (PM): retention: users mainly want to compare p95 across services quickly. suggest adding 'compare baseline' chip to the preset row. copy idea: 'Baseline (30d avg)'.
Marta (Design): love that. thinking of preset chips like: [Last 1h] [Last 6h] [Prod peak] [Baseline]. open to alternate microcopy for 'Prod peak' — alternatives: 'Peak window', 'Highest traffic'.
Sam (A11y): a11y nits: the chips need role="button" and keyboard focus states. color contrast on the active chip fails AA at 12px labels. also the sampling slider needs aria-valuemin/valuemax and visible focus ring.
Marta (Design): thanks Sam — for contrast I'm proposing a border + fill pattern for active state (not relying on color alone).
Sachin (Eng-Platform): about sampling defaults: current backend sends sampleRate=0.01 by default. we should surface that as 'Sample 1%' but not let people assume it's token-sampling vs request-sampling. suggest copy 'Sample: 1% of requests'.
Marta (Design): good point. I'm trying inline microcopy under the slider: 'Applies to rendering heatmap and p95 buckets — reduces datapoints.' alternative short label: 'Sampling (requests)'.
Eli (Eng-ML): also add tooltip explaining deterministic bucketting: 'Sampling uses consistent hashing by request id to keep comparisons stable.'
Marta (Design): here's the tooltip copy options, pick one:
```
Option A: 'Sampling reduces data volume by including a percentage of requests. Use higher sampling for performance-sensitive views.'
Option B: 'Only a subset of requests are shown. Samples are stable per request ID to preserve trends.'
Option C: 'Samples are applied to requests (not tokens). Increase to 100% for full fidelity.'
```
Anna (PM): prefer B short-term, A in docs. keep C in advanced tooltip.
Sam (A11y): keyboard flow: chips, presets, then timepicker, then sampling slider. ensure order matches DOM for screenreaders. Also add aria-describedby linking tooltip.
Sachin (Eng-Platform): implementation note: when sampling <5% we should auto-aggregate buckets to reduce flicker. we'll add an API param aggregated=true for those levels.
Marta (Design): visual for aggregated mode: show a thin hatch pattern over heatmap cells + small legend dot 'aggregated view'.
Eli (Eng-ML): performance note: progressive tile approach + aggregated flag should keep p95 calc within 200ms for 1k qps workload.
Marta (Design): final question: preferred quick-range preset labels? (1) '1h / 6h / Peak / Baseline' (2) 'Last 1h / Last 6h / Prod peak / 30d baseline' — vote please.
Anna (PM): 2
Sachin (Eng-Platform): 2
Sam (A11y): 2
Marta (Design): cool. I'll update comp, add aria attributes and new tooltip wording (option B) and push a Figma link in ~30m. thanks :zap:
deploy-bot: new figma link posted: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/latency-heatmap-v3
Eli (Eng-ML): quick follow: can you add a small note under p95 tooltip about what percentiles do not capture (spikes)? short copy: 'p95 hides very rare spikes — check p999 for tail events.'
Marta (Design): added that too. end thread.
